contexts.text: For the natural kingdom derives all its origin from the spiritual kingdom.

Every man... may know that he is in two kingdoms: a spiritual kingdom, and a natural kingdom: also that the spiritual kingdom is interior, and the natural kingdom exterior, and consequently that he can prefer the one to the other... But when he has the natural kingdom as the end... he then extinguishes those things which are of love to the Lord and charity towards the neighbour, and which are of faith... and makes the love of the world and of self... everything.
Egypt, in the representative sense, is the natural kingdom...

The Angels of the Lord's natural kingdom, from whom is the First or lowest Heaven, are in the Divine which proceeds from the Lord which is called the Divine Natural, and are in the faith of charity from the Lord.
The lowest Heaven makes the Lord's natural kingdom.
The intelligence of the Angels of the Spiritual Kingdom is ineffable and incomprehensible to those who are in the natural kingdom...
